# STANDARD MATERIALS OF CONSTRUCTION

(26" to 40") Lug

# Part List

Item: 1; Description: Body; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: CI ASTM A126 CLASS B / CI IS 210 FG 260 / DI ASTM A395 60-40-18 / ASTM A216 WCB; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A351 CF8/C8M/CF3M
Item: 2**; Description: Seat; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: EPDM/WHITE EPDM / NBR (BUNA-N)/WHITE NBR (WHITE BUNA-N) / Viton®(FKM) / Silicone#; Standard Material* SS: EPDM/WHITE EPDM / NBR (BUNA-N)/WHITE NBR (WHITE BUNA-N) / Viton®(FKM) / Silicone#
Item: 3; Description: Disc; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: ASTM A536 65-45-12+Nylon 12 coated / ASTM A536 65-45-12+Aroxy coated / ASTM A216 WCB+Nylon 12 coated / ASTM A216 WCB+Aroxy coated / ASTM A351 CF8M/CF8/CF3M / ASTM A995 4A/5A/6A / NAB ASTM B148 C95800; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A351 CF8M/CF8/CF3M / ASTM A995 4A/5A/6A / NAB ASTM B148 C95800
Item: 4; Description: Stem; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: ASTM A479 SS410-L2/SS316 SH / ASTM A564 17-4 PH Type 630 / ASTM A182 F51/F53; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A479 SS316 SH / ASTM A564 17-4 PH Type 630 / ASTM A182 F51/F53
Item: 5**; Description: U-Cup Seal; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: NBR (BUNA-N); Standard Material* SS: NBR (BUNA-N)
Item: 6**; Description: Stem Bushing; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Phosphor Bronze BS 1400 PB4; Standard Material* SS: Phosphor Bronze BS 1400 PB4
Item: 7**; Description: External Circlip; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Spring Steel IS 2507 70C6; Standard Material* SS: Spring Steel IS 2507 70C6

Item: 8; Description: Top Cover; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Carbon Steel IS 2062 Gr.B; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A240 SS304/ SS316
Item: 9; Description: Socket Head Cap Screw; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: IS 1367 HTS 12.9; Standard Material* SS: ISO 3506 A2-70
Item: 10**; Description: Bearing Spacer; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Carbon Steel IS 2062 Gr.B; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A240 SS304
Item: 11; Description: Thrust Bearing; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Phosphor Bronze BS 1400 PB4; Standard Material* SS: Phosphor Bronze BS 1400 PB4
Item: 12**; Description: ‘O’ Ring; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: NBR (BUNA-N); Standard Material* SS: NBR (BUNA-N)
Item: 13; Description: Bottom Plate; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Carbon Steel IS 2062 Gr.B; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A240 SS304/ SS316
Item: 14; Description: Plain Washer; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: Carbon Steel IS 2062 Gr-B; Standard Material* SS: ASTM A240 SS304
Item: 15; Description: Hex Head Bolt; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: IS 1367 HTS 12.9; Standard Material* SS: ISO 3506 A2-70
Item: 16; Description: Plug; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: ISO 3506 A2-70; Standard Material* SS: ISO 3506 A2-70
Item: 17; Description: Key; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: BS 970 En8; Standard Material* SS: BS 970 En8
Item: 18; Description: Socket Head Cap Screw; Standard Material* CI/DI/CS: ISO 3506 A2-70; Standard Material* SS: ISO 3506 A2-70

#Silicone seat configuration applicable up to PN6 rating only.
*Other materials may be available on request.

**Recommended spares.
CI = Cast Iron, DI = Ductile Iron, CS = Carbon Steel, SS = Stainless Steel.
